description: Land Title Settlement Department - Magalle, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810012
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
